note: state/prr-sweep/: last/<owner>_<repo> (epoch of the repo's last sweep), cursor/<owner>_<repo> (the status rotation), fixes.tsv (the fix ledger, <epoch> TAB <repo> TAB <number> TAB <field>, trimmed to PRR_SWEEP_QUIET_DAYS + 1 days at each tick), sweeps.tsv (<epoch> TAB <owner>_<repo>, one row for each completed sweep, same retention), attempt/<owner>_<repo> (a repo the lane tried; removed after PRR_SWEEP_QUIET_DAYS + 1 days with no try), first-sweep (epoch), raise/<lane> (epoch of the lane's last interval raise), alerted/<owner>_<repo> (an open fix-limit alert), tick.lock. Losing it costs one early sweep per repo, and the 7-day raise window starts again. Machine-local, never carried
